rationale: User asked what else from C:\Users\rafael\.wezterm.lua the GPUI POC can support. 020 already does font/size/scheme/scrollback/bell. Cheap leftovers that actually change behavior: tab_max_width, show_tab_index_in_tab_bar, hide_tab_bar_if_only_one_tab, switch_to_last_active_tab_when_closing_tab, and the file's mouse_bindings (Ctrl+click OpenLinkAtMouseCursor, Ctrl+wheel ScrollByPage, Ctrl+down Nop). Do not grow the HWND on font change (already matches adjust_window_size=false). Do not add a scrollbar widget, max_fps, palette fonts, default_prog, live reload, or wezterm-gui's full default InputMap. Open URI with wezterm-open-url on a side thread (no wezterm.on open-uri).
